content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification requirements prescribed for the post. Desirable qualifications, experience, and age limits are also evaluated during shortlisting. The age limit for the post is 35 years.

rows.desirable_qualification: Experience in clinical research or clinical trials, preferably in neonatal/pediatrics research for at least 1 year; experience in multicentre research; knowledge of clinical trial randomization procedures, data entry software like RedCap, willingness to travel to the participating centers across India for investigator training, site initiation, and other study-related activities; good written and verbal communication skills in English and Tamil.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) Job Description
content_sections.text: The engaged Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) will be responsible for the following duties: Overall coordination and day-to-day management of the multicentre SAFE-FEED trial at the coordinating centre. Coordinating with all participating centres to ensure uniform implementation of the study protocol. Organizing site initiation activities, investigator training, and periodic investigator meetings. Monitoring participant screening, recruitment, enrolment, and follow-up progress across centres. Ensuring protocol adherence, quality assurance, and consistency of study procedures across participating centres. Overseeing the implementation of the study randomisation process and ensuring adherence to the approved randomisation procedures and allocation concealment requirements. Overseeing data integrity, data quality checks, and timely completion of study documentation. Coordinating central monitoring, source data verification, and follow-up of protocol deviations. Coordinating regulatory documentation, progress reports, and communication with participating investigators. Assisting the Principal Investigator in overall project fund management, including budget monitoring, expenditure tracking, and preparation of financial statements and utilisation reports in coordination with the relevant institutional sections. Coordinating the procurement of study-related equipment, consumables, and other materials in accordance with the approved project budget and institutional procurement procedures. Monitoring study timelines and facilitating timely completion of project activities. Contributing to analysis, interpretation, and dissemination of study findings, including scientific reports and publications. Travel to the participating centers across India for investigator training, site initiation, and other study-related activities. Performing other duties related to the project as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Project Research Scientist-I (Medical)
content_sections.text: Download the application form attached with the notification and print it in A4 size paper and fill in with Block Letters with BLUE PEN. Affix your recent passport size photo on the application form (Do not staple). Compile your filled application form along with your CV and supporting documents (scanned in one pdf). Name the PDF file strictly as: “Candidate name_Post-name_year_application” (e.g., “James_PRS-I_2026_application”). Mention the name of the post applied for in the email subject line. Email the filled application form, along with CV and supporting documents (scanned in one pdf) to the Email ID: [email protected] by 10/11/2026 up to 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Proof of Identity (Copy of Aadhaar card/ Voter ID / Passport /Driving License) Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate) Degrees/Diplomas Experience certificates Proof of prior research experience, if any Any others (if relevant; specify) (All Certificates must be self-attested and attached in the specified order)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted based on the details furnished in the application, CV, and the documentary proof provided. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. The final selection will be based on CV, application, and written test and in person interview. Topics for evaluation/syllabus: Clinical research methodology, clinical trial conduct, randomised controlled trials and randomisation procedures, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), research ethics, neonatal and paediatric research, basic biostatistics, clinical trial data management (including REDCap), multicentre study coordination, and interpretation of clinical research findings.
